notes: horchow.com is fully retired: EVERY path on the domain (including /robots.txt and deep legacy category URLs) 302s to https://www.neimanmarcus.com/c/home-all-home-cat59040731?fromhc=true. Horchow's catalogue is now the Neiman Marcus Home department, so all rows are canonical neimanmarcus.com URLs. ACCESS: direct fetch and r.jina.ai were both blocked (DataDome on NM, Cloudflare challenge on jina). curl_cffi impersonating 'safari17_0' passed DataDome unchallenged on every request (desktop chrome131/chrome124 profiles were 403'd). Category tree recovered from the unprotected sitemap https://www.neimanmarcus.com/sitemap_category_1.xml.gz (3,629 URLs, 144 under /c/home) cross-checked against the left-nav Category facet on each PLP. COUNTS: taken from the rendered listing header 'product-list__header__items' ("N items"), which on this platform is identical to the SSR productListPage.total. Per Rule 1 this was NOT assumed - it was verified empirically on 17 nodes spanning 32 to 2,156 products by paginating to exhaustion (?page=N, 120 tiles/page, page N+1 returns HTTP 404) and counting unique "id":"prodNNNN" values. All 17 matched the header EXACTLY (e.g. Flush Mounts 120+30=150; Pendants 120+120+11=251; Wall Art 2,156; Accents 1,211; Drinkware 600; Serveware 592). Note: counting product-anchor hrefs instead undercounts (82 vs 90 on Chargers) because some slugs carry non-ASCII characters - the "id":"prodN" field is the reliable one. NO DOUBLE COUNTING: children sum to slightly under each parent in every branch (Home Decor children 6,080 vs parent 6,413; Dining & Entertaining 2,320 vs 2,857; Lighting 2,428 vs 2,443), so the left-nav facets are mutually exclusive rather than re-cuts. Pairwise product-ID overlap between the emitted Kitchen & Dining leaves is minor and genuine multi-category assignment, not subsetting (largest: Dinnerware x Serveware 58 of 463; Coffee & Tea x Serveware 16 of 125). DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED: Candles & Home Scents (863) - product titles are overwhelmingly scented candles, reed diffusers and room sprays, and NM offers no unscented child node; Faux Florals, Plants & Planters (511) - titles are almost entirely faux floral arrangements (the in-scope decorative planters were taken instead from Outdoor > Planters & Garden Accessories, 32); Curtains & Hardware (10) - all 10 products are drapery/curtain panels (textiles), no rods or tiebacks; Kitchen Accessories (171) - paper-towel and utensil holders, canisters, colanders, spoon rests, aprons (functional kitchen goods, not decor); Outdoor Decor (172) - heavily mixed with beach umbrellas, outdoor pillows and outdoor sconces; Ceiling Fans (21), Flatware (87), Table Linens (351), Decorative Pillows (320), Books (103), Desk & Stationery (155), Pet Beds (23), Bedding, Rugs, Bath, Furniture, Luggage, Tech & Games, Storage & Organization, Gourmet Food, and all Holiday nodes (Christmas, Hanukkah, Fall & Thanksgiving, Holiday Entertaining, Home Gifts). Designer/brand listing pages (e.g. /c/designers-jonathan-adler-decor) were skipped as brand pages, not categories. Note: 'Planters & Garden Accessories' sits under the site's Outdoor branch, not Home Decor.
